### Multiple Industry Honors Reinforce CSG/Netcracker Leadership in Customer Journey Orchestration and AI Innovation


September 24, 2026


*Customer engagement platform recognized for ability to orchestrate connected, AI-driven customer experiences*


DENVER--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- The next phase of customer experience hinges on how well brands turn customer data into relevant communications, real-time action, and responsible, proven AI use.[CSG](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.csgi.com%2F%3Futm_source%3DPress%2BRelease%26utm_medium%3DPR&esheet=54609858&newsitemid=20260924700756&lan=en-US&anchor=CSG&index=1&md5=128455ba6d8820fa424f897062ac8bd0) ® and[Netcracker Technology](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.netcracker.com%2F&esheet=54609858&newsitemid=20260924700756&lan=en-US&anchor=Netcracker+Technology&index=2&md5=60e9333c8036343be13df35209c402eb) today announced that CSG has been named a Leader in[The Forrester Wave™: Customer Journey Orchestration Platforms, Q3 2026](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.csgi.com%2Fresources%2F2026-forrester-wave-customer-journey-orchestration%3Futm_source%3Dbusinesswire%26utm_medium%3Dpress%2Brelease&esheet=54609858&newsitemid=20260924700756&lan=en-US&anchor=The+Forrester+Wave%26%238482%3B%3A+Customer+Journey+Orchestration+Platforms%2C+Q3+2026&index=3&md5=9782fd790905e79176de03911efe194e) , with the highest possible scores in 19 of 23 Forrester Wave™ criteria.[CSG Xponent](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.csgi.com%2Fproducts%2Fxponent%3Futm_source%3Dbusinesswire%26utm_medium%3Dpress%2Brelease&esheet=54609858&newsitemid=20260924700756&lan=en-US&anchor=CSG+Xponent&index=4&md5=0a1d774c81da780109ae6d492ff979ee) , a best-in-class customer engagement platform, helps brands land timelier, more relevant communications that drive customer action, secure loyalty, and bolster measurable business results.


[The Forrester Wave™: Customer Journey Orchestration Platforms](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.csgi.com%2Fresources%2F2026-forrester-wave-customer-journey-orchestration%3Futm_source%3Dbusinesswire%26utm_medium%3Dpress%2Brelease&esheet=54609858&newsitemid=20260924700756&lan=en-US&anchor=The+Forrester+Wave%26%238482%3B%3A+Customer+Journey+Orchestration+Platforms&index=5&md5=e3bbeb70906a706118c46c82fdfed8d2) states that, “CSG earns superior scores across the core journey intelligence and orchestration capabilities that define this market. Its excellent journey simulation, predictive intelligence, and decisioning capabilities help organizations evaluate likely outcomes before introducing changes into live journeys, improving decision confidence and reducing operational risk.”


Customers expect easier experiences, clearer communications, and responsible AI they can use with confidence. Xponent brings journey orchestration, customer communications management (CCM), and governed AI together to help brands deliver on those expectations. In the past six months, the platform has been recognized as a:


- **Leader** in[G2’s Fall 2026 CCM Software](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.csgi.com%2Flp%2Fcsg-xponent-g2-ccm%3Futm_source%3Dbusinesswire%26utm_medium%3Dpress%2Brelease&esheet=54609858&newsitemid=20260924700756&lan=en-US&anchor=G2%26%238217%3Bs+Fall+2026+CCM+Software&index=6&md5=74c5db6fbb984826d6396ee7f9a2174c) category, a direct result of positive customer feedback on the platform's ease of use, flexibility, and proven outcomes.
- **Leader** in the[QKS SPARK Matrix™ for CCM, Q3 2026](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.csgi.com%2Finsights%2Fhow-to-evaluate-ccm-vendors-what-buyers-can-learn-from-the-qks-spark-matrix-2026%3Futm_source%3Dbusinesswire%26utm_medium%3Dpress%2Brelease&esheet=54609858&newsitemid=20260924700756&lan=en-US&anchor=QKS+SPARK+Matrix%26%238482%3B+for+CCM%2C+Q3+2026&index=7&md5=378deee61f0693a57b8c094bfba176e5) , which reflects the evolution of CCM into a strategic layer to deliver intelligent, governed, and measurable customer experiences.
- **Winner** of the[2026 AI Breakthrough Award](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Faibreakthroughawards.com%2F2026-award-winners%2F&esheet=54609858&newsitemid=20260924700756&lan=en-US&anchor=2026+AI+Breakthrough+Award&index=8&md5=662533050a24ee6840fcb01d4398d70e) for "AI-Based Financial Services Solution of the Year," which recognizes our work helping financial services leaders deliver intelligent, easy customer experiences.
- **Winner** in the[Business Intelligence Group 2026 Artificial Intelligence Excellence Awards](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bintelligence.com%2Fposts%2F2026-artificial-intelligence-excellence-awards-honoring-the-organizations-products-teams-and-individuals-defining-what-ai-can-actually-do&esheet=54609858&newsitemid=20260924700756&lan=en-US&anchor=Business+Intelligence+Group+2026+Artificial+Intelligence+Excellence+Awards&index=9&md5=93aca7661b5ab7a403934627d3ef0eba) , which honors our approach to practical, governed AI that wins customer trust and loyalty.


“Brands have more customer data and more ways to communicate, yet customers still encounter confusing messages and unnecessary steps,” said Katie Costanzo, President of Customer Experience at CSG. “That’s why journey orchestration is so vital today—it allows brands to turn that knowledge into action, so they can spot customer needs sooner, communicate clearly, and make the experience effortless for the customer. We’re energized to see the impact of CSG/Netcracker Xponent recognized across the industry’s most prestigious analyst and award evaluations, as we help brands turn clear communication into measurable business results.”


“AI-driven journey orchestration, intelligent governance, and real-time decisioning are redefining how brands engage with their customers,” said Bob Titus, Chief Technology Officer at Netcracker Technology. “CSG/Netcracker Xponent helps brands move beyond isolated interactions by coordinating action across the customer journey and linking it to measurable business outcomes—from increased loyalty and revenue to greater operational efficiency. The recognition we’ve earned from leading analyst firms and industry awards underscores the value of applying AI with the governance and intelligence required to turn customer experience into a strategic business advantage.”


[CSG/Netcracker Xponent](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.csgi.com%2Fproducts%2Fxponent%3Futm_source%3Dbusinesswire%26utm_medium%3Dpress%2Brelease&esheet=54609858&newsitemid=20260924700756&lan=en-US&anchor=CSG%2FNetcracker+Xponent&index=10&md5=23f70d944b35bf2ab3dda501a99e3b3b) connects customer profiles, journey analytics, real-time decisioning, and omnichannel communications to coordinate experiences across the customer journey. In[The Forrester Wave™: Customer Journey Orchestration Platforms](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.csgi.com%2Fresources%2F2026-forrester-wave-customer-journey-orchestration%3Futm_source%3Dbusinesswire%26utm_medium%3Dpress%2Brelease&esheet=54609858&newsitemid=20260924700756&lan=en-US&anchor=The+Forrester+Wave%26%238482%3B%3A+Customer+Journey+Orchestration+Platforms&index=11&md5=e6f26189f81c097417f0f40a66afe2b1) , Xponent received the highest score possible in 19 criteria, including “predictive journey intelligence,” “journey success and business impact analysis,” and “AI framework, governance, and responsibility.”


Read[the full Forrester report](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.csgi.com%2Fresources%2F2026-forrester-wave-customer-journey-orchestration%3Futm_source%3Dbusinesswire%26utm_medium%3Dpress%2Brelease&esheet=54609858&newsitemid=20260924700756&lan=en-US&anchor=the+full+Forrester+report&index=12&md5=d6be3854e2f1e9ae210f098c599217f6) and explore how CSG/Netcracker helps brands across markets[orchestrate experiences that drive loyalty](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.csgi.com%2Fsolutions%2Fcustomer-engagement%2Fjourney-orchestration%3Futm_source%3Dbusinesswire%26utm_medium%3Dpress%2Brelease&esheet=54609858&newsitemid=20260924700756&lan=en-US&anchor=orchestrate+experiences+that+drive+loyalty&index=13&md5=5a86a3b17cc71abb2e7fe861e96483ef) .
